claim: For resource types that support full AWS Backup management, backups can use an encryption method other than the source resource's, controlled by the KMS key of the backup vault where the backup is stored.

values.display: independent encryption
encryption method other than one determined by the source resource's encryption

evidence.quote: AWS Backup offers independent encryption for resource types that support full AWS Backup management. Independent encryption means that recovery points (backups) you create through AWS Backup can have an encryption method other than one determined by the source resource's encryption.
